# Sandesh Kumar Gupta

> Cybersecurity student and researcher from Mathura, Uttar Pradesh, India. B.Tech CSE at GLA University (2024-2028). Focus: eBPF and Linux kernel security, machine-learning threat detection, VAPT and CTFs. Currently a Cyber Security Intern at the Amroha Police Cyber Security Internship Program (APCSIP-2026).

This is a one-page portfolio. Sections: projects, skills, about, certifications, contact.
